about_the_game:
【Game Introduction】

"Cryptic Glaze Mirror" is a plot-driven, mildly horror-themed puzzle otome game. You play as Shui Liuli, a newcomer to the workplace, who unexpectedly finds herself trapped in an ancient Western-style mansion. Not only must you explore the eerie environment and solve hidden puzzles, but you must also make choices between the twin acquaintances from the past—Mo Sheng and Mo Yi. Though outwardly amiable, both seem to harbor hidden secrets. Whom to trust and which path to take will be entirely up to you.

【Main Characters】

  • Shui Liuli (Protagonist)
    AGE: 23
    An ordinary office worker with a fashionable and attractive appearance but a homebody at heart. Introverted, not adept at expressing herself, and inwardly insecure.

  • Mo Sheng (Romanceable Character)
    AGE: 24
    The elder twin, a PhD student and part-time biology tutor. Calm and mature, always smiling. Excelled academically since youth.
    — “Why act so distant? I just want to become the closest person to my little bellflower ❤”

  • Mo Yi (Romanceable Character)
    AGE: 24
    The younger twin, a moderately famous internet celebrity and model on social media. Outgoing and well-connected.
    — “What a gloomy woman—I feel like mushrooms are about to grow on you!”

【Game Features】

  • Immersive mildly horror puzzle-solving experience: uncover the hidden truth in an ancient Western-style mansion

  • Multi-branch storyline choices + character-specific endings (HE/NE/BE) + hidden endings

  • Dozens of maps and CGs to unlock

content_descriptors.notes: Please note: The protagonist and all romanceable characters in the game are adults. This game contains mild horror elements (such as blood, violence, crime, etc.) and light sexual content. Some scenes or plots may cause discomfort.
